scope: Stored catalog coordinates/current source facets only; not new physical verification, live offers or approvals

japanese_charizard_names.sql: SELECT c.card_id,c.name,c.set_code,c.collector_number,f.value FROM card c JOIN discovery_card_facet f ON f.card_id=c.card_id AND f.facet_type='dex_id' AND f.value='6' WHERE c.language='ja' AND c.name='リザードン' ORDER BY c.card_id LIMIT 8

japanese_charizard_count.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) records,COUNT(DISTINCT c.set_code||':'||c.collector_number) coordinates FROM card c JOIN discovery_card_facet f ON f.card_id=c.card_id AND f.facet_type='dex_id' AND f.value='6' WHERE c.language='ja'

sv2a_count.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) records,COUNT(DISTINCT collector_number) coordinates FROM card WHERE language='ja' AND set_code='SV2A'

sv4a_known_nonmew_count.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) records,COUNT(DISTINCT c.collector_number) coordinates FROM card c JOIN discovery_card_facet f ON f.card_id=c.card_id AND f.facet_type='dex_id' AND f.value<>'151' WHERE c.language='ja' AND c.set_code='SV4A' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM discovery_card_facet m WHERE m.card_id=c.card_id AND m.facet_type='dex_id' AND m.value='151')

pikachu_others.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) records,COUNT(DISTINCT c.set_code||':'||c.collector_number) coordinates FROM card c JOIN discovery_card_facet f ON f.card_id=c.card_id AND f.facet_type='dex_id' AND f.value='25' WHERE c.language='ja' AND c.card_id<>'ja:SV4A:236/190:holo'
